P.name: Unseen Threat
P.description:
{{sbc|Innate:}} '''Kha'Zix''' gains ''Unseen Threat'' whenever the enemy loses {{tip|sight}} of him or he activates ''{{ai|Void Assault|Kha'Zix}}''.

{{sbc|Unseen Threat:}} '''Kha'Zix''' empowers his next {{tip|basic attack}} against an enemy champion to deal {{pplevel|17 to 136|color=magic damage}} {{as|(+ 50% '''bonus''' AD)}} {{as|'''bonus''' magic damage}} and {{tip|slow}} them by 25% for 2 seconds.

Q.name: Taste Their Fear
Q.description: {{sbc|Passive:}} '''Kha'Zix''' considers any enemy unit to be {{as|Isolated|buzzword}} if they are not nearby to one of their allies. ''{{ai|Taste Their Fear|Kha'Zix}}'', ''{{ai|Evolved Reaper Claws|Kha'Zix}}'', and ''{{ai|Evolved Spike Racks|Kha'Zix}}'' have special interactions against {{as|Isolated|buzzword}} targets.
Q.description2: {{sbc|Active:}} '''Kha'Zix''' slashes the target enemy, dealing {{as|physical damage}}, increased to 210% against {{as|Isolated|buzzword}} targets.
Q.leveling2:
{{st|Physical Damage|{{ap|80 to 180}} {{as|(+ 105% '''bonus''' AD)}}}}
{{st|Isolated Target Physical Damage|{{ap|80*2.1 to 180*2.1}} {{as|(+ {{ap|105*2.1}}% '''bonus''' AD)}}}}

Q.name: Evolved Reaper Claws
Q.description:
{{sbc|Passive:}} '''Kha'Zix''' gains {{sti|range|50 '''bonus''' range}} on his {{tip|basic attacks}} and ''Taste Their Fear''.

{{sbc|Evolved Bonus:}} If the target is {{as|Isolated|buzzword}}, the {{sti|cooldown}} is reduced by 45%.

W.name: Void Spike
W.description: {{sbc|Active:}} '''Kha'Zix''' fires a bolt of spikes in the target direction that explodes upon hitting an enemy, dealing {{as|physical damage}} to nearby enemies.
W.description2: '''Kha'Zix''' {{tip|heals}} himself if he is within the explosion.

W.name: Evolved Spike Racks
W.description: {{sbc|Evolved Bonus:}} ''Void Spike'' now fires three clusters in a cone, {{tip|slow|slows}} by 40% and {{tip|standard sight|reveals}} enemy champions hit for 2 seconds. Multiple explosions do not deal additional damage against the same target nor provide '''Kha'Zix''' with extra healing.
W.description2: {{as|Isolated|buzzword}} targets hit by ''Evolved Spike Racks'' are {{tip|slow|slowed}} by 60% instead.

E.name: Leap
E.description: {{sbc|Active:}} '''Kha'Zix''' {{tip|dash|leaps}} to the target location, dealing {{as|physical damage}} to nearby enemies upon arrival.
E.description2: ''{{ai|Taste Their Fear|Kha'Zix}} can be cast during the dash.''

E.name: Evolved Wings
E.description: {{sbc|Evolved Bonus:}} ''Leap'' gains 200 '''bonus''' cast range, and the {{sti|cooldown}} resets upon scoring a champion {{tip|takedown}}.

R.name: Void Assault
R.description:
{{sbc|Passive:}} Each rank in ''Void Assault'' allows '''Kha'Zix''' to evolve one of his {{tip|abilities}}, granting it additional effects. Evolving an ability causes him to enter a 2-second [[cast time]].

'''''Kha'Zix''' cannot evolve while he is affected by {{tip|cast-inhibiting crowd control}} or a {{tip|lockout}} that disables abilities.''
R.description2: {{sbc|Active:}} '''Kha'Zix''' becomes {{tip|invisible}} for {{ap|1.25}} seconds, during which he gains {{sti|ms|{{as|40% '''bonus''' movement speed}}}}.
R.description3: After 2 seconds of leaving {{tip|invisibility}}, and for the next 12 seconds, ''Void Assault'' can be recast at no additional cost.

R.name: Evolved Adaptive Cloaking
R.description: {{sbc|Evolved Bonus:}} The {{tip|invisibility}} now lasts 2 seconds, and ''Void Assault'' can be recast twice.
